key.name: config-dir
key.description: Directory containing config.xml. Empty: auto-detect ($XDG_STATE_HOME/syncthing, then ~/.config/syncthing).

key.name: gui-uri
key.description: For example http://127.0.0.1:8384. Empty: taken from config.xml.

key.name: toggle-window
key.summary: Shortcut to open or hide the Syncthing window

key.name: window-mode
key.summary: How the Syncthing window is opened
key.description: command: run window-command. uri: open the GUI URI in the default browser.

key.name: window-command
key.summary: Command that opens the Syncthing window
key.description: Run in a shell. Filled in with the Exec line of the GNOME Web app whose URL matches the GUI URI as soon as one is found. Empty: no such web app yet; the default browser is used.

key.name: first-run-done
key.summary: Whether the one-time setup of the Syncthing window has run
key.description: On first run, with GNOME Web installed, a Syncthing web app is created if none matches the GUI URI and window-command is set to it. Without GNOME Web, window-mode is set to uri and gui-uri to the address from config.xml.
